name: search_memory
description: Search structured memory entries and verbatim observations for a project. Output keeps legacy memory_entries / relation_facts / observations arrays and adds an additive recall contract with evidence, sources, steps, planning, and status.

scope.description: Search scope: project or all (default: project)

memory_type.description: Optional MemoryEntry.memory_type filter; multiple values are OR-ed.

include_history.description: v1.7.0: include historical structured truth. Default false returns current truth only.

include_provisional.description: v0.8.8: include provisional auto-promoted truth (down-weighted). Default false.

deep_recall.description: v4.0.4: include cold/archive lifecycle tiers. Default false searches hot/warm only.

retrieval_profile.description: v5.9.1: opt-in retrieval profile for this call. 'light' keeps the default path; 'quality' enables deterministic query rewrite/fanout metadata with a noop reranker. It does not enable HyDE or a heavy reranker by default.

task.description: v4.1: optional current task used by context sufficiency checks.

budget_tokens.description: v4.1: advisory context budget for ContextPlan / wake packet traces.
